fullDesc: At the 2016 Rio Olympics, American gymnast Simone Biles won four gold medals and one bronze. She became the most decorated gymnast in world championship history and later returned for Paris 2024.
realFacts: She has more than 30 combined Olympic and world medals
Several skills are named after her
She withdrew from events in Tokyo 2020 to protect her mental health
She won three golds in Paris 2024
